note: Quan Vu UR round 2 (ur-spectacle 49.6). STAGED r2b: r876 b pieces (items 1-3, 5, 7, with the 49.7 fixes) + r885 a coil1/coil2 back/front (axis_x, collar_top_y, head_w_px in each; the pole passes between back and front; scale 1, height 0.65 L baked), slab1-3 and chip1-8 (scale 0.5). Format = ur_prod.json: r = atlas rect, pv = pivot px in the piece, css_per_px, native px (never resampled, ~1.97 px/css); straight alpha; cut by difference to BOARD_PLATE_EMPTY.
